description.value: A Subway franchise located inside the Okanagan Lake Shopping Centre on Highway 97 in West Kelowna, offering made-to-order Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread. The location serves breakfast and supports catering orders in addition to its standard menu. Cycling tourists on the Highway 97 corridor have access to quick pickup or dine-in options at this shopping centre stop.

address.value: 525 Highway 97 South Unit #910 (D3), West Kelowna, BC V1Z 4C9
